sources.title: Gmail authorization scopes
sources.supports: Read-only mailbox access is restricted; server storage/transmission can require a security assessment.

sources.title: Restricted-scope verification
sources.supports: Public-launch prerequisites and assessment rules; confirm applicability for the final implementation.

sources.title: Cloudflare Pages bindings
sources.supports: Pages Functions can call a bound Worker service; verify cookie/origin behavior in the deployed app.

sources.title: Drive authorization scopes
sources.supports: drive.file limits the application to files it creates or the user selects for it.

sources.title: Queues delivery guarantees
sources.supports: At-least-once delivery requires idempotent consumers; do not assume ordering.

sources.title: Queues pricing
sources.supports: Free operations and 24-hour retention; paid allowances; retry operation costs.

sources.title: D1 limits
sources.supports: Per-database size, query constraints, and plan-dependent Time Travel retention.

sources.title: Workers limits
sources.supports: Runtime and request/CPU limits; benchmark rather than assume free-tier suitability.

sources.title: Workers pricing
sources.supports: Free allowances and paid subscription baseline; recheck before deployment.

sources.title: D1 pricing
sources.supports: Rows read/written and storage billing; indexes matter.

sources.title: D1 Database API
sources.supports: Prepared statements and batch API; test actual atomic/fencing behavior, not generic ORM transaction assumptions.

sources.title: Gmail synchronization
sources.supports: Full/partial sync and expired history recovery.

sources.title: Google OAuth 2.0
sources.supports: Token lifecycle and external Testing-mode refresh-token expiry exceptions.

sources.title: Microsoft Graph mail overview
sources.supports: Personal and organizational mailbox support; service/account restrictions remain relevant.

sources.title: Microsoft Graph permissions
sources.supports: Delegated Mail.Read versus insufficient basic-mail access.

sources.title: Microsoft Graph message delta
sources.supports: Per-folder delta state and opaque continuation links.

sources.title: Microsoft Graph immutable IDs
sources.supports: Request header and lifecycle limitations for stable message identifiers.

sources.title: Yahoo developer access
sources.supports: Commercial access is not a guaranteed instant OAuth integration; defer until verified.

sources.title: Proton Mail Bridge
sources.supports: Desktop-local bridge is not a drop-in Cloudflare cloud mailbox connector.

sources.title: Better Auth Google provider
sources.supports: Google login integration; not a reason to conflate app identity and additional mailbox authorizations.

sources.title: Better Auth Drizzle adapter
sources.supports: Adapter setup; select and pin compatible stable versions after the runtime spike.

sources.title: Drizzle D1 connection
sources.supports: D1 integration exists; check stable package versions and runtime behavior.

sources.title: Cloudflare Vitest integration
sources.supports: Tests in the Workers runtime rather than Node-only mocks.

sources.title: Workers AI Markdown conversion
sources.supports: Candidate document-conversion adapter, not an OCR accuracy guarantee.

sources.title: Markdown supported formats
sources.supports: Check supported MIME formats and test numeric fidelity for actual receipt types.

sources.title: Workers AI data usage
sources.supports: Service data-use policy; check model licensing and the selected processing path.

sources.title: Workers AI pricing
sources.supports: Account-level allowance and model-dependent costs; not a guaranteed number of free receipts.

sources.title: Frankfurter API
sources.supports: Current v2 API, historical rates and providers; prefer a stated provider such as ECB and persist exact rate snapshots.

sources.title: Google API Services User Data Policy
sources.supports: Limited Use, security, and transfer rules also matter for derived data and processors.

sources.title: OWASP prompt injection prevention
sources.supports: Treat document instructions as untrusted input; combine structural controls and output validation.

sources.title: OWASP SSRF prevention
sources.supports: Constrain destinations, redirects, and network reachability for configurable providers.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2
sources.supports: AA is the accessibility target, not a certification supplied by an automated test.

sources.title: Codex skills
sources.supports: Canonical skill layout and discovery; the documentation may redirect to ChatGPT Learn.

sources.title: Codex subagents
sources.supports: Native role TOML layout, required fields, and concurrency configuration; smoke-test installed version.

sources.title: Claude Code subagents
sources.supports: Native Markdown frontmatter, role tools, and skill loading behavior.

sources.title: OpenCode agents
sources.supports: Native agent Markdown and permission options.

sources.title: OpenCode skills
sources.supports: Agent Skills discovery, including .agents/skills; avoid conflicting duplicate names.

sources.title: Agent Skills specification
sources.supports: SKILL.md name/description metadata and directory naming rules.

sources.title: Cloudflare official skills repository
sources.supports: Optional upstream reference only; review and pin before importing third-party instructions.

sources.title: Drive upload management
sources.supports: Pre-generated IDs support safe retry for supported file types, including binary invoice archives.

sources.title: Clint pricing
sources.supports: Vendor-published free allowance with Gmail/Drive sync and USD 5/month individual plan; not a usability or accuracy benchmark.

sources.title: SparkReceipt pricing and inbox features
sources.supports: Vendor-published tiered inbox access and historical imports; baseline competitor features, not measured quality.

sources.title: Gennai pricing
sources.supports: Vendor-published free automatic capture with two inboxes at limited invoice volume.

sources.title: Google OAuth 2.0 policies
sources.supports: Public homepage and privacy/terms, secure external authorization, partial-scope handling, and contextual incremental authorization.

sources.title: Google Workspace user data and developer policy
sources.supports: Transparent limited use, disclosure and user consent, advertising/sale restrictions, and processing/security obligations.
